description: Angular component for a notification dialog in the Thingsboard UI, managing notification requests, previews, and delivery methods.

classes.name: SentNotificationDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing the sent notification dialog, including form handling, preview generation, and delivery method configuration.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without returning data.

methods.name: nextStepLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for the next step button based on current step index.

methods.name: changeStep
methods.description: Handles step change events in the stepper, updating the selected index and fetching preview if on last step.

methods.name: backStep
methods.description: Navigates to the previous step in the stepper.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Advances to the next step or submits the notification request if on the last step.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new notification request via the notification service and closes dialog on success.

methods.name: getPreview
methods.description: Fetches a preview of the notification request.

methods.name: notificationFormValue
methods.description: Constructs and returns the current form value as a NotificationRequest object.

methods.name: allValid
methods.description: Checks if all steps in the stepper are valid.

methods.name: isSysAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has SYS_ADMIN authority.

methods.name: isTenantAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has TENANT_ADMIN authority.

methods.name: minDate
methods.description: Calculates the minimum date based on timezone and current time.

methods.name: maxDate
methods.description: Calculates the maximum date (7 days from minDate).

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Opens dialog to create a notification target and adds it to the targets list.

methods.name: getDeliveryMethodsTemplatesControl
methods.description: Returns the form control for a specific delivery method's enabled state.

methods.name: getDeliveryMethodsTooltip
methods.description: Provides tooltip text for a delivery method.

methods.name: allowConfigureDeliveryMethod
methods.description: Determines if the current user can configure a specific delivery method.

methods.name: isInteractDeliveryMethod
methods.description: Checks if a delivery method is interactable (disabled but allowed to configure).

methods.name: configurationPage
methods.description: Returns the URL for configuring a specific delivery method.

methods.name: refreshAllowDeliveryMethod
methods.description: Refreshes the list of allowed delivery methods from the server.

methods.name: updateDeliveryMethodsDisableState
methods.description: Enables or disables delivery method controls based on allowed methods.
